/*******************************************************************************
* Instrument: ILL_H512_D22  (SANS D22 @ ILL, H51/H512 guide + Vsel + sample)
*
* Rebuilt from specification. Two-lambda gravity guide, Al windows as
* PowderN "dummy" scatterers, velocity selector, collimation guide,
* Isotropic_Sqw sample, 2D detector.
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT ILL_H512_D22(lambda=4.5, dlambda=0.45, D22_collimation=2,
                                string D22_sample="H2O_liq.qSq")

DECLARE
%{
double sT3;
double sI3;
double sT2;
double sI2;
double sT1;
double sI1;
double gR0;
double gQc;
double gAlpha;
double gW;
double Al_Thickness;
double gGap;
double D22_nu;
int flag;
%}

USERVARS
%{
int splitflag;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  sT3 = 413.5;
  sI3 = 1.022e+13;
  sT2 = 145.8;
  sI2 = 3.44e+13;
  sT1 = 40.1;
  sI1 = 2.78e+13;
  gR0 = 1;
  gQc = 0.0216;
  gAlpha = 4.07;
  gW = 1.0/300.0;
  Al_Thickness = 0.001;
  gGap = 0.001;
  D22_nu = 0;
  flag = 0;

  D22_nu   = 3956*48.3*DEG2RAD/2/PI/lambda/0.25;
  printf("ILL_H512_D22: D22:  nu=%g [rpm] lambda=%g [Angs] sample=%s\n",
    D22_nu*60, lambda, D22_sample);
%}

TRACE

COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS = Source_gen(
    radius=0.21/2, dist=2.155, focus_xw=0.123, focus_yh=0.120,
    lambda0=lambda, dlambda=dlambda, I1=sI1, verbose=1,
    T1=sT1, T2=sT2, I2=sI2, T3=sT3, I3=sI3, zdepth=0.15)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE Origin
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0.21) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0.61) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_0 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0.78) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_1 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0.92) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_2 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 2.15) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H5 = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (0, 0, 2.155) RELATIVE HCS
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_origin = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (-(0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06)/2+0.04/2, 0, 0) RELATIVE H5
ROTATED (0, -1.3269, 0) RELATIVE H5

COMPONENT H51_Start = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE H51_origin
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_inpile = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE H51_Start
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_Obt_1 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 2.775+0.025) RELATIVE H51_inpile
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_Obt_2 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.863+0.012) RELATIVE H51_Obt_1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_Obt_3 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 1.433+0.012) RELATIVE H51_Obt_2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_3 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0.745+0.01) RELATIVE H51_Obt_3
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_Obt_Out = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (0, 0, 0.06) RELATIVE HCS_Al_copy_3
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_4 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE H51_Obt_Out
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_S2 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.05) RELATIVE HCS_Al_copy_4
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_S2_copy = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 2.5/3) RELATIVE H51_S2
ROTATED (0, -2.5/3/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H51_S2

COMPONENT H51_S2_copy_0 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 2.5/3) RELATIVE H51_S2_copy
ROTATED (0, -2.5/3/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H51_S2_copy

COMPONENT HCS_Al_H51 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 2.5/3+0.01) RELATIVE H51_S2_copy_0
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_S2_Out = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (0, 0, 0.05) RELATIVE HCS_Al_H51
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_split_2 = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (0, 0.12/2-0.055/2, 0) RELATIVE H51_S2_Out
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
  if(SCATTERED) splitflag=2;
%}

COMPONENT H51_split_1 = Monitor_nD(
    xwidth=0.04+0.004+0.015+0.004+0.06, yheight=0.12, bins=50, options="x y, slit")
AT (0, -0.12/2+0.055/2, 0) RELATIVE H51_S2_Out
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
  if(SCATTERED) splitflag=1;
%}

COMPONENT H511_Start = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE H51_split_1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
  if (splitflag==1) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT H512_Start = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE H51_split_2
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H512_S36 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.0) RELATIVE H512_Start
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_0 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy

ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_0

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_1
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_1

ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_2

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_4 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_3
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_3

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_5 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_4
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_4

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_6 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_5
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_5

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_7 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_6
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_6

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_8 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_7
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_7

    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_8
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_8

COMPONENT H512_S36_copy_10 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_9
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_9

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_10
ROTATED (0, -20.85/16/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_10

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_11

AT (0, 0, 20.85/16) RELATIVE H512_S36_copy_12

    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)

ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_S78 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.05) RELATIVE HCS_Al_copy_5

COMPONENT H51_S78_copy = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,

AT (0, 0, 6.0/4) RELATIVE H51_S78

    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 6.0/4) RELATIVE H51_S78_copy
ROTATED (0, -6.0/4/3000*RAD2DEG, 0) RELATIVE H51_S78_copy

COMPONENT H51_S78_copy_1 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_6 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 6.0/4+0.01) RELATIVE H51_S78_copy_1
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H512_S11 = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.01) RELATIVE HCS_Al_copy_6
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT HCS_Al_copy_7 = PowderN(reflections="Al.laz", yheight=0.12, xwidth=0.17,
    zdepth=Al_Thickness, p_inc=0.005, p_transmit=0.9450, d_phi=10, p_interact=0.05)
AT (0, 0, 3+0.01) RELATIVE H512_S11
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D22_PreV = Monitor_nD(xwidth=0.04, yheight=0.05, bins=50,
    restore_neutron=1, options="x y")
AT (0, 0, 0.01) RELATIVE HCS_Al_copy_7
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D22_Vselector = V_selector(xwidth=0.04, yheight=0.05, zdepth=0.30,
    radius=0.12, alpha=48.3, length=0.25, d=0.0004, nu=D22_nu, nslit=72)
AT (0, 0, 3+0.01+0.3+0.01) RELATIVE H512_S11
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D22_Collimation = Guide_gravity(w1=0.04, h1=0.12, l=2.775,
    R0=gR0, Qc=gQc, alpha=gAlpha, m=1.2, W=gW)
AT (0, 0, 0.3) RELATIVE D22_Vselector
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT D22_Sample_Pos = Arm()
AT (0, 0, 20+0.3) RELATIVE D22_Vselector
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_D22_Sample_Div = Monitor_nD(xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.05, bins=100,
    restore_neutron=1, options="dx limits=[-2 2], dy limits=[-2 2]")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D22_Sample_Pos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_D22_Sample_XY = Monitor_nD(xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.05, bins=50,
    restore_neutron=1, options="x y")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D22_Sample_Pos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT H51_D22_Sample_L = Monitor_nD(xwidth=0.02, yheight=0.05, bins=50,
    restore_neutron=1, options="lambda limits=[1 10]")
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D22_Sample_Pos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE

SPLIT 10 COMPONENT H51_D22_Sample = Isotropic_Sqw(
    Sqw_coh=D22_sample, Sqw_inc="NULL", radius=0.005, yheight=0.05,
    d_phi=RAD2DEG*atan2(1, D22_collimation))
AT (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE D22_Sample_Pos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
  if (!SCATTERED) ABSORB;
%}

COMPONENT D22_Detector = Monitor_nD(xwidth=1, yheight=1, bins=128, options="x y")
AT (0, 0, D22_collimation) RELATIVE D22_Sample_Pos
ROTATED (0, 0, 0) RELATIVE ABSOLUTE
EXTEND
%{
  ABSORB;
%}

FINALLY
%{
%}

END
